study.name: Retest: Phase 2e: H4 Example Ordering
study.description:
Tests 4 example ordering strategies to determine if position of canonical
vs hard examples affects detection performance. Includes the config-default
baseline (reused from Phase 2c) plus 3 reordering variants.
Uses all optimal parameters from Phases 2a-2d.
Final phase before Phase 3 validation.
study.retest_notes: H4 example ordering (image-using). All at T=0.0.
